description: Effect of non-microbial plant biostimulants on crop yield in open-field trials. Biostimulant categories include seaweed extracts, protein hydrolysates, humic/fulvic acids, chitosan, silicon, and phosphite. Based on Li et al. 2022 (Frontiers in Plant Science 13:836702).
intervention: Plant biostimulant application (seaweed extract, humic acid, fulvic acid, protein hydrolysate, chitosan, silicon, phosphite)
typical_effect_size: +17.9% average yield increase across all categories
moderators: Biostimulant type (SWE, PHs, PE, HFA, Chi, Si, Phi)
Application method (soil drench, foliar spray, seed treatment)
extraction_priorities: 1. CRITICAL: Extract EVERY treatment combination separately
2. Control = untreated/no biostimulant; treatment = with biostimulant
3. If multiple rates or application timings, extract EACH vs control
5. Focus on FRESH YIELD as primary outcome
6. Watch for different units (g/plant vs kg/ha vs t/ha)
tc_confusion_warnings: Some papers test multiple biostimulant products -- extract each vs control
Factorial designs (biostimulant x rate x timing): extract each combination
Watch for different units across papers
notes: Papers span many crop species and biostimulant types. Record both carefully as moderators.
